channel.title: Epic Fury Live — US-Iran War Tracker
channel.description: Live tracking of the US-Israel-Iran conflict. Real-time updates, verified casualties, evidence, and analysis.

item.title: Houthis launch new attacks on al-Makha and Marib as Yemen conflict escalates
item.description: Houthi missile and drone strikes target Marib and al-Makha, killing at least four people and injuring eight.

item.title: ‘Limited options’ for many Iranians as war with US chokes economy
item.description: Millions of Iranians struggle to make ends meet as war with US devastates the economy and sends prices soaring.

item.title: Trump threatens to make the Strait of Hormuz a US territory: Can he?
item.description: US president has yet another outlandish threat for Iran, with no end to war in sight.

item.title: Why has Israel escalated attacks in southern Lebanon despite ceasefire?
item.description: At least 11 people killed in one day of Israeli attacks despite truce extension brokered by US in June.

item.title: Cincinnati Open: Djokovic stunned by Tirante in second round
item.description: Novak Djokovic struggled in the hot conditions and was ousted from Cincinnati Open in his first match since Wimbledon.

item.title: At least 12 people killed in Hungary bus crash
item.description: Bus carrying Polish tourists overturns, killing 12 people and injuring 10 others on the M3 motorway near Mezokeresztes.

item.title: Australia to begin gun buyback scheme in response to Bondi shooting
item.description: Australia will begin buying back guns in November, almost a year after a shooting at Sydney's Bondi killed 15 people.

item.title: Five killed as Russia launches fresh aerial attacks across Ukraine
item.description: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky accuses Russia of targeting civilian infrastructure, while Moscow reports that a warehouse was hit.

item.title: Thousands displaced by deadly Indonesia earthquake as rescue efforts continue
item.description: Hundreds of homes and public buildings have been severely damaged with at least 53 people killed.

item.title: Twelve killed as Polish bus veers off Hungarian motorway
item.description: Dozens more are seriously injured after the tourist bus overturned in the early hours of Sunday morning.
